measurement_method: PowerShell Get-Process working-set polling every 100 ms around audit_native1080_pixels.py.
run_scope: both VVP raw frames decoded to visible RGB, metrics and previews generated one frame at a time
notes: Raw inputs are read with numpy.memmap; Y/Cb/Cr visible planes are untiled one frame at a time; RGB conversion uses two-luma-row chunks. This is sampled process working set, not a formal peak-allocation bound.
